say:1:1241142001:1.source_cn: 你们知道，我不是个诚实的人……

choice_prompt:2:1241142001.source_cn: 你们知道，我不是个诚实的人……

say:3:1241142002:1.text: Hey, there are things I've been honest about too! Like I'm flat broke and really need money!
say:3:1241142002:1.source_cn: 喂，我说的实话不少！比如说，我穷得很，而且想要钱想得要命！

say:4:1241142003:1.text: Anyway... I wouldn't have faced my true desires if it weren't for you guys.
say:4:1241142003:1.source_cn: 但是……如果没有你们，我不会诚实地面对自己内心的渴望。

say:5:1241142004:1.text: I wouldn't have gotten this compass either.

choice_prompt:6:1241142004.text: I wouldn't have gotten this compass either.

say:7:1241142005:1.text: Haha, didn't know you could be funny!
say:7:1241142005:1.source_cn: 哈哈，你居然也会开玩笑了？
say:7:1241142005:1.male: Haha, didn't know you could be funny!
say:7:1241142005:1.female: Haha, didn't know you could be funny!

say:8:1241142007:1.text: The compass can take me anywhere my heart leads me...
say:8:1241142007:1.source_cn: 只要跟随心之所向，罗盘就能带我去任何地方……

say:9:1241142008:1.text: Now, I know where to go and what to do.
say:9:1241142008:1.source_cn: 我现在知道自己要去哪里，自己要做什么。

say:10:1241142009:1.text: I've never felt this liberated before.
say:10:1241142009:1.source_cn: 我从未感觉自己如此自由。

say:11:1241142010:1.text: I owe this to you all!

say:13:1241142011:1.text: We haven't done much. I think... you're following the path your father set for you ages ago.
say:13:1241142011:1.source_cn: 我们没做什么。我想……辛巴达现在踏上的路，应该是很早以...

say:14:1241142012:1.text: You're right... He used to promise me every time he came back from the sea that when I grew up, he'd take me aboard and let me join his adventures.
say:14:1241142012:1.source_cn: 是啊……他以前每次出海回来，都答应我，等我长大，就允许...

say:15:1241142013:1.text: I'll always remember how the morning sunlight shone on his beard when he said that.
say:15:1241142013:1.source_cn: 我永远记得他说这话的时候，锈锚港的晨光照在他胡子上的样子。

say:16:1241142014:1.text: Everything still feels pretty surreal to me even now.
say:16:1241142014:1.source_cn: 到现在，我还有种做梦一样的不真实感。

say:17:1241142015:1.text: Hey, do you think I'll ever find him?
say:17:1241142015:1.male: Hey, do you think I'll ever find him?
say:17:1241142015:1.female: Hey, do you think I'll ever find him?

choice_prompt:18:1241142015.text: Hey, do you think I'll ever find him?
choice_prompt:18:1241142015.source_cn: <male>兄弟</male><female>妹子</female>你说，我还能找到他吗？
choice_prompt:18:1241142015.male: Hey, do you think I'll ever find him?
choice_prompt:18:1241142015.female: Hey, do you think I'll ever find him?

say:19:1241142016:1.text: In fact, I already know the answer deep down inside.
say:19:1241142016:1.source_cn: 其实我心里已经有了答案。

say:20:1241142017:1.text: Look at the ships on the sea. They come and go, meeting each other and then parting ways again... That's life.
say:20:1241142017:1.source_cn: 你瞧，这海上来来往往的船只，相遇，又散开……这就是生活。
say:20:1241142017:1.male: Look at the ships on the sea. They come and go, meeting each other and then parting ways again... That's life.
say:20:1241142017:1.female: Look at the ships on the sea. They come and go, meeting each other and then parting ways again... That's life.

say:21:1241142018:1.text: Isn't facing separation directly also a kind of adventure?
say:21:1241142018:1.source_cn: 直面离别，又何尝不是一场伟大的冒险？

choice:18:1:2.text: You will if you stay hopeful.
choice:18:1:2.male: You will if you stay hopeful.
choice:18:1:2.female: You will if you stay hopeful.

say:23:1241142006:1.text: *Sigh*... After putting on an act for so long, I sometimes even forget who I really am.
say:23:1241142006:1.source_cn: 唉……面具戴久了，有时候都卸不下来了。

choice:6:1:2.text: Lying is just your way of protecting yourself.
choice:6:1:2.male: Lying is just your way of protecting yourself.
choice:6:1:2.female: Lying is just your way of protecting yourself.

choice:2:1:2.text: Am I in a dream? You aren't lying!
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 变天了，你竟然在说实话！
choice:2:1:2.male: Am I in a dream? You aren't lying!
choice:2:1:2.female: Am I in a dream? You aren't lying!
